intro: Palms sits between Culver City and West LA, a dense grid of apartments and strip malls along Venice, National and Motor, with some of the Westside's best casual cooking and the Expo Line close by.

to: Time Out: The best restaurants in LA
gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)

places.w: A small, friendly espresso bar on Motor known for Australian-style coffee and a well-made matcha.
places.o: A flat white or the matcha.

places.w: A busy little sandwich shop where the specialty is banh mi on fresh, soft bread.
places.o: A tofu or Korean BBQ banh mi.

places.w: One of the best ramen shops on the Westside, known for a rich tonkotsu broth. You order on tablets.
places.o: Tonkotsu or the spicy miso ramen.

places.w: A longtime LA Cuban restaurant with big plates and a lively dining room.
A warm Latin-Caribbean dining room and bar whose cocktails use fresh-pressed sugar cane.
places.o: Mango curry chicken and a mojito.

places.w: Chef Niki Nakayama's celebrated modern kaiseki tasting menu, one of the hardest reservations in LA.
places.o: Watch the reservation page for new dates and book the moment they drop.
